name: King Crimson

whyMatters.en: Robert Fripp–centered progressive band formed in London in 1969. Three clear phases—symphonic debut, mid-70s improv edge, 1980s Discipline dual-guitar—each leave a catalog mark while Fripp stays constant.
whyMatters.zh: 以 Robert Fripp 为中心的 progressive 乐队，1969 年于伦敦成立。三个清楚阶段——交响首专、70 年代中期即兴边缘、80 年代《Discipline》双吉他——各自留下目录标记，Fripp 始终保留。

shortBio.en: London progressive rock, 1969–. Fripp constant across casts; Court, Red, and Discipline mark three eras.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦 progressive rock，1969 年至今。Fripp 跨阵容保留；Court、《Red》、《Discipline》标记三个时期。

body.en:
King Crimson formed in London in 1969 with Robert Fripp (guitar), Ian McDonald (woodwinds/keys), Greg Lake (vocals/bass), Michael Giles (drums), and Pete Sinfield (lyrics). Fripp had been in Giles, Giles & Fripp; the new band was different. In the Court of the Crimson King (1969) hit both sides of the Atlantic: Epitaph and the title track as solemn Mellotron pieces, 21st Century Schizoid Man as heavy attack.

US-tour fallout broke the debut lineup. In the Wake of Poseidon (1970) still sold well with Mel Collins and Gordon Haskell among replacements. Lizard (1970) featured Keith Tippett and Yes singer Jon Anderson; Islands (1971) with Boz Burrell and Ian Wallace closed the first stylistic phase.

A 1972 restart brought John Wetton, Bill Bruford (ex-Yes), David Cross, Jamie Muir, and lyricist Richard Palmer-James (ex-Supertramp founding circle). Larks’ Tongues in Aspic (1973), Starless and Bible Black, and Red (1974) are the mid-era peak before Fripp dissolved the band again.

The 1981 return paired Fripp and Bruford with Adrian Belew (ex–Frank Zappa; also on Bowie’s Lodger and 1978 live shows) and Tony Levin (from Peter Gabriel). Discipline (1981), Beat (1982), and Three of a Perfect Pair (1984) pushed interlocking guitar and Stick bass at the hard-rock / jazz-rock edge. After a decade apart, the mid-1990s “double trio” added Trey Gunn and Pat Mastelotto (Thrak, 1995); later albums include The ConstruKction of Light (2000) and The Power to Believe (2003). Activity paused in 2009 and resumed in 2014.
body.zh:
King Crimson 于 1969 年在伦敦成立，成员为 Robert Fripp（吉他）、Ian McDonald（木管/键盘）、Greg Lake（主唱/贝斯）、Michael Giles（鼓）与 Pete Sinfield（作词）。Fripp 曾在 Giles, Giles & Fripp；新乐队不同。《In the Court of the Crimson King》（1969）两岸都有成绩：《Epitaph》与同名曲偏庄严 Mellotron，《21st Century Schizoid Man》则是重攻击。

美国巡演余波拆散首专阵容。《In the Wake of Poseidon》（1970）仍畅销，替换者包括 Mel Collins、Gordon Haskell。《Lizard》（1970）有 Keith Tippett 与 Yes 主唱 Jon Anderson；《Islands》（1971，Boz Burrell、Ian Wallace）结束第一风格阶段。

1972 年重启引入 John Wetton、Bill Bruford（前 Yes）、David Cross、Jamie Muir，以及作词 Richard Palmer-James（Supertramp 创始圈）。《Larks' Tongues in Aspic》（1973）、《Starless and Bible Black》与《Red》（1974）是中期高峰，随后 Fripp 再度解散。

1981 年回归由 Fripp、Bruford 搭配 Adrian Belew（前 Frank Zappa；亦参与 Bowie《Lodger》与 1978 现场）与 Tony Levin（来自 Peter Gabriel）。《Discipline》（1981）、《Beat》（1982）、《Three of a Perfect Pair》（1984）在硬摇滚/爵士摇滚边缘推进交织吉他与 Stick 贝斯。十年间歇后，90 年代中期「双三重奏」加入 Trey Gunn、Pat Mastelotto（《Thrak》，1995）；之后有《The ConstruKction of Light》（2000）、《The Power to Believe》（2003）。2009 年休整，2014 年恢复。

body.en:
The book frames King Crimson in three phases: symphonic-rock pioneer (Court era), progressive / jazz-rock edge (Wetton/Bruford), and advanced interlocking music (Discipline onward).

Fripp remains; bass, drums, vocals, and reeds change by decade. The versions are the catalog.
body.zh:
书中把 King Crimson 分成三阶段：交响摇滚试验（Court 时期）、progressive / 爵士摇滚边缘（Wetton/Bruford）、更前沿的交织写法（《Discipline》以降）。

Fripp 保留；贝斯、鼓、人声与簧乐按年代更换。这些版本就是目录本身。

title.en: In the Court of the Crimson King
title.zh: 《In the Court of the Crimson King》

body.en:
1969 debut with Lake, McDonald, Giles, Sinfield, and Fripp. Epitaph and the title track use solemn Mellotron; 21st Century Schizoid Man opens with distorted vocal, sax, and a heavy riff.

It is the clearest early symphonic-rock reference in this chronicle.
body.zh:
1969 年首专，阵容为 Lake、McDonald、Giles、Sinfield、Fripp。《Epitaph》与同名曲用庄严 Mellotron；《21st Century Schizoid Man》以失真人声、萨克斯与重 riff 开场。

这是本编年中最清晰的早期交响摇滚参照。

body.en:
After 1972, Wetton, Bruford (from Yes), Cross, and briefly Muir recorded Larks’ Tongues in Aspic. Starless and Bible Black and Red tightened the improvising edge before Fripp stopped the band again.

Jon Anderson’s Lizard cameo and Bruford’s Yes past are the main Yes cross-links.
body.zh:
1972 年后，Wetton、Bruford（来自 Yes）、Cross 与短暂加入的 Muir 录制《Larks' Tongues in Aspic》。《Starless and Bible Black》与《Red》收紧即兴锋芒，随后 Fripp 再度停队。

Jon Anderson 在《Lizard》客串与 Bruford 的 Yes 履历，是与 Yes 的主要交叉联系。

body.en:
Belew arrived from Frank Zappa’s band and Bowie’s late-1970s circle (Lodger; 1978 live). Levin came from Peter Gabriel. With Fripp and Bruford they made Discipline, Beat, and Three of a Perfect Pair.

Interlocking dual guitar and Stick bass define Elephant Talk–era Crimson. Belew’s Bowie/Zappa path is the clearest cross-band thread.
body.zh:
Belew 来自 Frank Zappa 乐队与 Bowie 1970 年代末圈子（《Lodger》；1978 现场）。Levin 来自 Peter Gabriel。与 Fripp、Bruford 录制《Discipline》《Beat》《Three of a Perfect Pair》。

交织双吉他与 Stick 贝斯定义《Elephant Talk》时期 Crimson。Belew 的 Bowie/Zappa 路径是最清楚的跨乐队线索。

body.en:
In 1994 Trey Gunn and Pat Mastelotto joined Fripp’s “double trio” idea (Thrak, 1995). Bruford and Levin left temporarily later; The ConstruKction of Light (2000) and The Power to Believe (2003) continued the experiments.

A 2009 pause lasted until 2014.
body.zh:
1994 年 Trey Gunn 与 Pat Mastelotto 加入 Fripp 构思的「双三重奏」（《Thrak》，1995）。Bruford 与 Levin 后来暂时离开；《The ConstruKction of Light》（2000）与《The Power to Believe》（2003）继续试验。

2009 年休整至 2014 年恢复。

body.en:
Math rock and experimental metal often cite shifting meters and frequent lineup reform. Radiohead and Tool listeners also point to Schizoid Man and Discipline-era interlocking parts.

Influence is sonic and procedural: how a band reconstitutes itself under one guitarist’s standards.
body.zh:
Math rock 与实验金属常引用变换拍号与频繁阵容重组。Radiohead 与 Tool 听众也会指向《Schizoid Man》与 Discipline 时期交织声部。

影响兼及声音与程序：乐队如何在同一吉他手的标准下重组。
